# Run ledger — P0.06 Engine, AgentSdkEngine, two-uid run-task image, event mapper

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/06_P0.06__engine-and-run-task.md (+ spec §12.2, §12.4 step 4, §12.5, §12.6, §13.5, §11.5)
- **Base commit:** 22003b348b6fe4bd8e12b3958b5f578ae3fd0a30 (P0.05 boundary hooks)
- **Branch:** stevevitali/p0-06-engine-and-run-task (stacked on P0.05)
- **Env facts:** Docker present (v29). macOS host: no `unshare`, no Linux uids natively. Agent SDK NOT installed (vendored at deploy; DI it). Baseline green: 326 tests / 78 build tasks.

## Requirements (from ticket Load + spec)
- R1 packages/engine: `Engine {startPhase(req):AsyncIterable<EngineEvent>; abort(reason); usage()}`; AgentSdkEngine per §12.2; stub ManagedAgentsEngine passing same conformance suite (REQ-ARCH-7); FakeEngine replaying recorded fixtures (G21).
- R2 apps/run-task image: two uids (harness/agent), scrubbed env, harness-only secrets file, Unix-socket hook daemon agent-uid can't read, read-only rootfs + tmpfs, distroless ARM64.
- R3 Input-scoped subagents (REQ-DATA-17/18; REQ-ARCH-19 amended): orchestrator-launched separate query() in private mount ns (`unshare -m` + tmpfs binds) under distinct uid, exactly enumerated files, tools:["Read"], no Bash; drafting never fans out; producerQueryId recorded.
- R4 Event mapper (packages/engine/mapper/): SDK msgs → §12.5 typed events; conformance suite + fixtures; agent.note only from contracts notes.ts (REQ-ARCH-14); source.read URL from tool RESULT not model request (REQ-ARCH-15); whitelist validation; internal vs user split (REQ-ARCH-12); per-phase usage.tick.
- R5 OTel config all content flags off (§13.5).
- §12.2 engine options verbatim: cwd, baked skills, agents roster, hooks, permissionMode:"dontAsk", cosmetic disallowedTools, maxBudgetUsd, maxTurns, scrubbed env, subagent depth 1, ≤5 concurrent, 1-h caching, OTel, S3 sessionStore, abortController.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 (det) privilege-separation in built image: uid agent can't read token/cred file or hook socket creds; SDK env is only scrubbed set (REQ-SPEC-10).
- AC2 (det) shell escape (`node -e` HTTP from agent) reaches neither internal API (no token) nor provider (proxy refuses credential-less; stub proxy).
- AC3 (det) mapper conformance green on fixtures; CI asserts no internal type emitted as user; hostile fetched-page text never reaches agent.note (REQ-ARCH-14).
- AC4 (det) input-scoped subagent: scoped mount ns contains exactly enumerated files; a Read outside fails at the KERNEL not just the hook (F13).
- AC5 (det) ManagedAgentsEngine stub + AgentSdkEngine both pass event-mapper conformance suite (REQ-ARCH-7).
- AC6 (agentic) one live phase (editorial-review phase 0 on a fixture) end-to-end via AgentSdkEngine in dev → piece brief + valid phase-result.json.

## Req IDs to stamp
REQ-ARCH-7, REQ-ARCH-14, REQ-ARCH-15, REQ-SPEC-10, REQ-DATA-17, REQ-DATA-18, REQ-ARCH-19 (amended), ledger G15/G18/G21/M11; §12.2 engine options; §13.5 OTel content-flags rule.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- No secret reachable from the model's process (REQ-ARCH-30; REQ-SPEC-10).
- Trust chip rests on facts the sandbox cannot touch — nothing here may forge audit rows, fetch-log rows, or events (§12.6).

## Plan (approach)
Design keystone: everything is dependency-injected so it is testable under Node now (SDK not installed;
no Linux uid/mountns on macOS). The Agent SDK is a thin adapter behind an injected `query` fn.

packages/engine/src/
  engine.ts        Engine iface, PhaseRequest, EngineEvent(MappedEvent), UsageSnapshot, ResultSubtype, PhaseResult
  sdk-types.ts     minimal structural subset of Agent SDK messages the mapper consumes (system/assistant/user/result/stream_event)
  scrubbed-env.ts  buildAgentEnv() → only RUN_ID, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; asserts secrets absent
  otel.ts          buildOtelConfig() all content flags off (§13.5)
  options.ts       buildQueryOptions(req) → §12.2 options object verbatim
  usage.ts         usage accumulator from SDK usage blocks
  mapper/          mapEvents/createMapper (SDK msgs → typed run events + result); notes via contracts renderNote; source.read url from tool RESULT; internal/user guard; usage.tick
  mapper/fixtures/ recorded scenarios (happy, subagents+fetch, gate, cancel, budget, refusal, hostile-page)
  agent-sdk-engine.ts    AgentSdkEngine implements Engine (DI query fn) → mapper
  managed-agents-engine.ts stub, same mapper (REQ-ARCH-7)
  fake-engine.ts   replays recorded fixtures (G21)
  scoped-subagent.ts input-scoped subagent launch SPEC builder: role→enumerated files, unshare -m cmd, distinct uid, tools:["Read"], producerQueryId
  conformance.test.ts (AC3/AC5), *.test.ts alongside

apps/run-task/src/
  secrets.ts       read RUN_TOKEN/API_INTERNAL_URL/proxy-cred from harness-only file
  hook-daemon.ts   Unix-socket daemon (harness) holding token, evaluateToolUse via @rhema/hooks
  hook-client.ts   agent-side client → socket
  bootstrap.ts     harness→agent launch spec (scrubbed env, uid drop args), proxy cred injector
  index.ts         entry
Dockerfile         ARM64, distroless-node runtime, read-only rootfs + tmpfs, two-uid entrypoint (docker/entrypoint.sh)

## Test matrix (AC → tests)
- AC1: scrubbed-env.test (env is exactly the scrubbed set; secrets absent) + run-task secrets.test (harness-only mode 0600, agent uid EACCES — logic + optional docker) + DEFER in-image kernel run.
- AC2: run-task proxy stub test — credential-less request → 403; escaped `node -e` has no token/cred (bootstrap env has neither) + DEFER in-image run.
- AC3: mapper/conformance.test — every fixture maps to expected events; no internal type as user (REQ-ARCH-12); hostile-page fixture never yields agent.note carrying page text (REQ-ARCH-14); source.read url from tool result (REQ-ARCH-15).
- AC4: scoped-subagent.test — launch spec enumerates exactly the files, builds `unshare -m`+tmpfs binds, distinct uid, tools:["Read"] + DEFER in-image kernel-read-fail.
- AC5: conformance.test runs both AgentSdkEngine and ManagedAgentsEngine paths through the shared mapper → identical events.
- AC6: agentic — DEFER (needs live dev SDK+Anthropic). Provide the runnable path + a fixture-driven FakeEngine e2e as a proxy.

- Green gate: `pnpm turbo build typecheck lint` → 78 tasks OK. `pnpm test` → 55 files, 423 tests pass (baseline 326 → +97).
- Engine: 76 tests (conformance 27, options 10, scoped 15, scrubbed 7, mapper 7, otel 4, roster 4, fake 2).
- run-task: 20 unit + 1 docker-gated. proxy.test uses live stub http servers (403 credential-less, 401 no-token, 200 injected).
- KERNEL evidence (AC1/AC4): `docker build -f apps/run-task/Dockerfile.privsep-test` + `docker run --rm --cap-add SYS_ADMIN` →
  "PASS AC1 harness reads / PASS AC1 uid agent denied (EACCES) / PASS AC4 scoped ns exactly enumerated, out-of-set read fails at kernel / ALL PRIVSEP CHECKS PASSED". Wired as apps/run-task/src/privsep.docker.test.ts (gated: local + integration job).
- Production Dockerfile builds (`docker build -f apps/run-task/Dockerfile`) — CI `images` job safe.
- AC6 deferred (D-P0.06-1). Image hardening/SDK-vendor deferred (D-P0.06-3/4). AC1/2/4-in-CI (D-P0.06-2).
- Independent fresh-context review: returned 2 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 2 LOW, 1 nit. Dispositions:
  - HIGH-1 (scoped-runner didn't isolate at kernel — no overmount/pivot; test proved a different mechanism): FIXED — scoped-runner.sh + buildScopedLaunchSpec now do stash-outside→overmount /work→ro-bind (the mechanism privsep-check.sh proves). ScopedMountPlan gained overmountDir/stashDir/stashBinds.
  - HIGH-2 (tmpfs mounted ro then written → EROFS): FIXED — tmpfsArgv now rw (nosuid,nodev,size); files bound ro. Unit test asserts no 'ro' on tmpfs.
  - MED-3 (usage double-count: result usage is cumulative, was added): FIXED — setUsageTotals overwrites on result; regression test + fake-engine total corrected to 9000.
  - MED-4 (malformed resolved URL crashes stream via z.url throw): FIXED — isAbsoluteHttpUrl guard skips bad source.read; driveMapper per-message try/catch backstop → internal engine.error; test added.
  - MED-5 (entrypoint dropped caps → harness can't setpriv to agent): FIXED — entrypoint retains ambient CAP_SETUID+CAP_SYS_ADMIN for the harness supervisor; agent launch keeps --no-new-privs.
  - LOW-7 (hook daemon unbounded line buffer DoS): FIXED — MAX_LINE_BYTES cap, connection destroyed on overflow.
  - nit (assertHarnessOnly owner check only when expectedUid passed): FIXED — readHarnessSecrets defaults owner to process.getuid().
  - LOW-6 (fresh AbortController per startPhase loses a pre-iteration abort): WONTFIX — each startPhase is a new phase; abort cancels the in-flight phase (the real usage); AbortController.abort() is itself idempotent. Recorded as intentional.
  - Security invariants (REQ-SPEC-10/ARCH-12/14/15, socket) verified holding by the reviewer.
- Re-verified after fixes: full gate green — 78 build/typecheck/lint tasks; 425 tests (55 files).
